children: joined a modest global equity rally on Thursday after the Federal Reserve's first rate hike since 2023 helped steady bond markets, while oil prices fell on easing supply concerns.
The index rose 0.4% in a second day of gains after hitting 3-month lows, with travel (.SXTP), tech (.SX8P) and auto (.SXAP) stocks leading advances. Chemicals (.SX4P) lagged, down 0.4%.
Among top fallers, industrial group Bilfinger
fell 21% after cutting its outlook, while Raiffeisen
fell 8% after Grizzly disclosed a short position and alleged the lender's involvement in sanctions-restricted Russian trade.
About 65% of STOXX 600 constituents traded higher.
rose 0.4% in line with broader European markets, ahead of the Bank of England's policy announcement later in the day.
